notes: method: 'weighted_mean' averages the value at each quantile level across models
(a weighted Vincent average). This is the same aggregation hubEnsembles
performs by default and preserves the monotonicity of each input's quantiles.
default_weight: weight applied to any eligible model not listed in 'weights'.
weights: per-model overrides keyed by model_id. Weights are relative, not
absolute: they are renormalised over the models that actually contributed to
each horizon, so a missing submission does not shrink the ensemble. Set a
model to 0 to exclude it while keeping the record of that decision.
min_models: a horizon is only written when at least this many models supplied a
complete set of required quantile levels for it.
Leaving 'weights' empty means an equal-weight mean over all eligible models.
To move to accuracy-based weighting, set weights inversely proportional to each
model's WIS on a recent evaluation window (see 02-Dashboard/predevals-config.yml
for the evaluation sets) and record the window used in 'weights_updated'.
